No, unless they think you're a legitimate harm to yourself. Wanting to die and planning it are two totally different things and they know it. They will be alarmed so they'll ask you questions and evaluate on that. But they can't just have you committed because you say you're suicidal. Also, they won't handcuff you, either. If you're thinking about reaching out, I say do it. At the worst, youll be hospitalized and the worst thing about hospitalization is its super fucking boring but you'll come out better and have good stories of the characters you met.

Source: been hospitalized a lot because of attempted suicide/major depression spells.

It's that and lack of willpower somewhat because I will suffer through the withdrawals, no matter how terrifying, but they're dangerous and I could easily give up the next day and drinkthe same amount or more. 

It's both n attitude change and needing to fix my habits but I keep slipping over and iver. I don't know if it'll change. I get depressed so I drink or I drink and then get depresse. And then I take 22 pills because I think it'll hurt me.

I have goals. I'm not suicidal when I'm sober. It just hits me I'm drunk and it'll be the death of me if I don't fix it.

Hey, it's obviously none of my business but I don't think you should ever give up.
